lines.en: label sadgirls5:
scene harukaandco1
: Hah...
: How’d it go? Were you able to say everything you wanted to say?
lines.zh: : 谈得怎么样?你想说的都说了吗?

lines.en: : Who knows? I think it went well, but I’m notoriously bad at judging how things are going while they’re actually, you know, {i}happening.{/i}
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢?我觉得挺顺利的,不过我出了名地不擅长在事情正……你知道的,正在{i}发生{/i}的时候判断它进展如何。

lines.en: scene harukaandco2
: Well, you’re not alone there. I think Otoha’s mad at me since I didn’t talk Chika out of joining the light music club with us.
lines.zh: : 嗯,这点你可不孤单。我觉得 Otoha 在生我的气,因为我没有劝住 Chika 别跟我们一起加入轻音部。

lines.en: : You left the manga club? It’s not because of the whole Molly thing, is it?
lines.zh: : 你退出漫画社了?不是因为 Molly 那档子事吧?

lines.en: : No. That doesn’t really have anything to do with it.
lines.zh: : 不是。那件事跟这个没关系。

lines.en: : Okay. Good. Because I’m calling her in and the two of you are going to be running the rest of the shift together.
lines.zh: : 好。那就好。因为我要把她叫来,接下来这一班你们俩一起盯。

lines.en: scene harukaandco3
: I’m sorry, what?
lines.zh: : 抱歉,你说什么?

lines.en: : Think you can deal with each other long enough to keep the cafe from burning down?
lines.zh: : 你觉得你们能忍住彼此,撑到下班、别把咖啡馆烧了吗?

lines.en: : Haruka, you understand that leaving me alone to run the shift with Molly means that I’m {i}basically{/i} going to be running things alone, right?
lines.zh: : Haruka,你明白的,让我一个人跟 Molly 一起看班,{i}基本上{/i}等于让我一个人干完所有活,对吧?

lines.en: : Yeah. But I trust you and think you can handle it.
lines.zh: : 是的。但我信任你,觉得你应付得来。

lines.en: scene harukaandco4
: Oh, you’re {i}good.{/i} You know I won’t be able to say no after flattery like that.
lines.zh: : 哦,你可{i}真行{/i}。你明知道被这么一捧,我就没法拒绝了。

lines.en: : Fuck it. Bring on the weeb. I got this shit.
lines.zh: : 管他呢。把那个死宅叫来吧。这点事我扛得住。

lines.en: : Thanks, Rin. I appreciate that.
lines.zh: : 谢谢,Rin。我很感激。

lines.en: scene harukaandco5
: What are {i}you{/i} gonna do, then? Go meet up with Makoto’s mom? Or are you gonna go back home and try to erase all the traces of Sensei for when your husband comes back?
lines.zh: : 那{i}你{/i}打算干嘛?去找 Makoto 她妈妈?还是回家把 Sensei 留下的痕迹都抹干净,好等你丈夫回来?

lines.en: : I still have no idea when my husband will be coming back, nor do I understand what “traces” Sensei would even leave behind.
lines.zh: : 我还不知道我丈夫什么时候回来,而且我也不明白 Sensei 能留下什么「痕迹」。

lines.en: : Oh, you know. Condoms. Razors. All kinds of...manly stuff. Whatever dudes carry around with them.
lines.zh: : 哦,你知道的。避孕套。剃须刀。各种……男人味的东西。反正男人随身带的那套。

lines.en: if harukasex == False:
scene harukaandco6
: He has no need for condoms when that’s absolutely not the type of relationship we have.
lines.zh: : 他用不着避孕套,因为我们之间绝对不是那种关系。

lines.en: : Hey, I didn’t say they had to be for {i}you.{/i} He’s a popular guy, you know? He could be slamming some girl he just met on the street right now and we’d have no idea.
lines.zh: : 嘿,我又没说那些是给{i}你{/i}用的。他很受欢迎的,好吗?他这会儿说不定正在街上操一个刚认识的女孩,我们根本不会知道。

lines.en: : I just hope he didn’t leave all his condoms at your house.
lines.zh: : 我只希望他没把避孕套都落在你家。

lines.en: : Rin.
lines.zh: : Rin。

lines.en: else:
scene harukaandco6
: You know, I’d really appreciate it if you’d stop pointing out my infidelity now that my husband has come back into the picture.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,既然我丈夫已经重新回到画面里了,你能不能别再提我出轨的事了,我会很感激的。

lines.en: : Why? If your heart’s with Sensei, what good does waiting on him even do?
lines.zh: : 为什么?如果你的心在 Sensei 身上,等他回来又有什么意义?

lines.en: : Rin-
lines.zh: : Rin——

lines.en: : I’m serious, Haruka.
lines.zh: : 我是认真的,Haruka。

lines.en: : I love you and want you to be happy. And I feel like you’ll be making a big mistake if you just cut everything off because of one phone call.
lines.zh: : 我爱你,也希望你能幸福。而且我觉得,如果只因为一通电话就把一切都切断,你会犯一个大错。

lines.en: scene harukaandco7
: You should know by now that this isn’t something I can just {i}cut off.{/i} It’s a lot more complicated than that.
lines.zh: : 你现在该明白了,这不是我{i}说断就能断{/i}的东西。比那复杂得多。

lines.en: : Well, whatever the case may be, I’d like to reinforce my role on Team Sensei. And no, it’s not just because I want to watch you guys do it.
lines.zh: : 好吧,不管怎样,我想重申一下我在「Sensei 队」的立场。而且不,不只是因为我想看你们俩做。

lines.en: : Which I might.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。

lines.en: : I mean, what? Who said that?
lines.zh: : 我是说,什么?谁说的?

lines.en: : Don’t fire me.
lines.zh: : 别炒我鱿鱼。

lines.en: : Rin...stop.
lines.zh: : Rin……够了。

lines.en: scene harukaandco8
: So, what now? How are you gonna kick off your girls’ day out on the town?
lines.zh: : 那么,接下来呢?你们的「闺蜜进城一日游」要怎么开场?

lines.en: : We’re not going {i}out on the town.{/i} And frankly, I’d be surprised if Maki even {i}would{/i} go out on the town with me after how I treated her yesterday.
lines.zh: : 我们不是去「{i}进城一日游{/i}」。而且说实话,按我昨天那么对 Maki,她愿不{i}愿意{/i}跟我出门我都觉得稀奇。

lines.en: : Well, it’s not like you meant to treat her that way, is it? You had your own stuff going on. It’s only natural to think about that first.
lines.zh: : 嗯,你又不是故意那么对她的,不是吗?你自己也有一堆事。先顾自己很正常。

lines.en: : As long as you can apologize and be sincere about it, I’m sure you guys can work it out.
lines.zh: : 只要你肯道歉,而且是真心诚意地道歉,我相信你们能解决的。

lines.en: : Yeah...I’m just not really sure how to apologize for something as serious as this. Especially when she’s going through one of the hardest things she’ll ever have to right now.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我只是不太确定,这么严重的事该怎么道歉。尤其是她现在正在经历她一生中最难熬的事之一。

lines.en: scene harukaandco9
: Yeah...after starting to piece things together, I can kinda see that...
lines.zh: : 是啊……把这些事一点点拼起来之后,我也多少能看出来……

lines.en: : I wish I had some sort of advice I could give you...but I’ve never really been good at dealing with that sort of thing myself either and-
lines.zh: : 我真希望我能给你点什么建议……可我自己也从来不太擅长应付这种事,而且——

lines.en: scene harukaandco10
: Wait! What about flowers?
lines.zh: : 等等!那花呢?

lines.en: : Flowers?
: Yeah!
lines.zh: : 对啊!

lines.en: : Any time my mom gets into a fight with my {i}other{/i} mom, she always buys her flowers to say she’s sorry. Then, before you know it, they’re back to normal like there was never any fight at all.
lines.zh: : 每次我妈跟我{i}另一个{/i}妈吵架,她都会买花给她道歉。然后不知不觉,她们就和好如初了,像从没吵过架一样。

lines.en: : This might not work since you and Maki don’t have sex with each other, but I think it’s worth a shot!
lines.zh: : 这招可能不管用,因为你和 Maki 又不上床,不过我觉得值得一试!

lines.en: : Who says Maki and I don’t have sex with each other?
lines.zh: : 谁说我和 Maki 不上床了?

lines.en: : Come again?
lines.zh: : 你说什么?

lines.en: scene harukaandco11
: Kidding.
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的。

lines.en: : But...yeah. Maybe a gesture like that {i}would{/i} make things a little bit better. Thanks for the suggestion, Rin.
lines.zh: : 不过……对。也许像这样的心意{i}能{/i}让事情好一点。谢谢你的建议,Rin。

lines.en: : Were you really kidding just now? And, if so, can you tell me you {i}weren’t?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你刚才真的是在开玩笑吗?如果是的话,你能告诉我你{i}不是{/i}吗?

lines.en: : Nope. I’ve got things to do.
lines.zh: : 不能。我还有事要做。

lines.en: scene harukaandco12
: I’ll call Molly now and make sure she comes over, but I’m going to head out if that’s okay with you. You’ll be fine alone for a little while, right?
lines.zh: : 我现在就给 Molly 打电话,确保她过来,不过如果你没意见的话我要先走了。你一个人待一会儿没问题吧?

lines.en: : Rin?
lines.zh: : Rin?

lines.en: : Okay. See you later, then.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那回头见。

lines.en: scene black
{i}Somewhere else, shortly after....{/i}
lines.zh: {i}不久之后,在另一个地方……{/i}

lines.en: scene harukaandco13
{i}Flowers, flowers, all around us; to grow and then decay-{/i}
lines.zh: {i}花啊花,围绕我们四周;生长,然后凋零——{/i}

lines.en: {i}To parallel our livelihoods and mirror passing days.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}映照我们的生计,也映射流逝的日子。{/i}

lines.en: {i}When you speak into that mirror, what is it you will say?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}当你对着那面镜子说话,你会说些什么?{/i}

lines.en: {i}Are you excited for the future? Or do you wish it all away?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你是对未来感到兴奋?还是希望这一切都消失?{/i}

lines.en: {i}To heart, my friends and family! For these mirrors are just jokes!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}振作起来吧,我的朋友和亲人!因为这些镜子不过是玩笑!{/i}

lines.en: {i}The flowers reek of simile! The metaphors of oak!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}那些花散发着明喻的臭味!那些橡树般的隐喻!{/i}

lines.en: {i}Reverse! Return! Repeat your words! If you keep them in, you’ll choke.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}倒转!回头!把你的话重复一遍!憋在心里,你会窒息。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Press the flowers to your nose; breathe them in like smoke.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}把花按在鼻子上;像吸烟一样把它们吸进去。{/i}

lines.en: {i}- The girl who cannot breathe{/i}
lines.zh: {i}——那个无法呼吸的女孩{/i}

lines.en: Hello!
lines.zh: 你好!

lines.en: Narrator here again.
lines.zh: 旁白又来了。

lines.en: Did you miss me?
lines.zh: 想我了吗?

lines.en: I’ve decided to drop in and speak to you directly about what might be happening while you’re away.
lines.zh: 我决定插一脚,直接跟你们聊聊,在你们不在场的时候可能发生着什么。

lines.en: It’s come up in the past — the question of trees falling in forests and whether or not they make sounds — and I’d like to confirm here and now that they do!
lines.zh: 过去一直有人问——森林里的树倒下时到底有没有声音——我想在此确认:有!

lines.en: The issue is that the sounds happen so far away from all of us that’s it’s kind of hard to pinpoint exactly {i}what{/i} noises are produced.
lines.zh: 问题在于,那些声音发生在离我们太远的地方,很难准确说出到底发出了{i}什么{/i}样的响动。

lines.en: So all we have to go off of are past experiences. Memories of what sounds {i}should{/i} be made and how long they will last.
lines.zh: 所以我们能依靠的只有过去的经验。关于「应{i}该{/i}发出什么声音、持续多久」的记忆。

lines.en: Perhaps what you will see next is one of those assumptions.
lines.zh: 也许你接下来看到的,就是其中一个假设。

lines.en: Or perhaps I just like playing games with you.
lines.zh: 又或许,我只是喜欢跟你玩游戏。

lines.en: Does it happen?
lines.zh: 它发生了吗?

lines.en: Does it not?
lines.zh: 还是没有?

lines.en: You will never know!
lines.zh: 你永远不会知道!

lines.en: But I will.
lines.zh: 但我会。

lines.en: And you are lucky that I am willing to share even this much.
lines.zh: 而你能听到我这里愿意透露的这一点点,已经算走运了。

lines.en: Sayonara.
lines.zh: 再见。

lines.en: : Let’s see...I think flowers should be-
lines.zh: : 让我想想……我觉得花应该在——

lines.en: : You! With the boobs! Come here!
lines.zh: : 你!那个有胸的!过来!

lines.en: scene harukaandco14
: Huh? Me?
lines.zh: : 啊?我?

lines.en: : Yes! You! Help me!
lines.zh: : 对!你!帮帮我!

lines.en: : Umm...
: Hurry! This is an emergency! My entire life hangs in the balance of this very decision!
lines.zh: : 快点!这是紧急情况!我整个人生都悬在这个决定上!

lines.en: scene harukaandco15
: How can I-
lines.zh: : 我该怎么——

lines.en: : Pink or blue?!
lines.zh: : 粉色还是蓝色?!

lines.en: : Uhh...can I ask what the occasion is?
lines.zh: : 呃……我能问一下是什么场合吗?

lines.en: : Repentance!
lines.zh: : 忏悔!

lines.en: : I think I need a little more to go off of than just that.
lines.zh: : 我觉得光凭这个,我还需要多一点线索。

lines.en: scene harukaandco16
: I think pink is probably the right choice. Blue comes on too strong. Pink is like “Please forgive me,” while blue is like “I’m fucking sorry, okay?”
lines.zh: : 我觉得粉色大概是对的。蓝色来得太冲。粉色像是「请原谅我」,而蓝色像是「我他妈真的很抱歉,行了吧?」

lines.en: : Umm...
scene harukaandco17
: Here. Take these. I have made my decision and you look like you’re here for flowers as well.
lines.zh: : 给。拿着这些。我已经决定了,而且你看起来也是来买花的。

lines.en: : Is that...really how I-
lines.zh: : 那……真的是我——

lines.en: scene harukaandco18
: Well, I guess I don’t have to {i}look{/i} for flowers anymore.
lines.zh: : 好吧,看来我不用再{i}找{/i}花了。

lines.en: : Mmm...I don’t know about this. I’m starting to have second thoughts about pink.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我不确定。我开始对粉色动摇了。

lines.en: : You know, this whole ordeal would be a hell of a lot easier if they had yellow. I always get yellow. This is the first time I have ever been faced with such a tough decision.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,要是有黄色的话,这整件事会容易得多。我向来都买黄色。这还是我第一次面对这么艰难的决定。

lines.en: scene harukaandco19
: Also, hi. Nice to meet you. I swear I’m not normally as crazy as this. You just caught me at a weird time.
lines.zh: : 还有,你好。很高兴认识你。我发誓我平时没这么疯。你只是赶上了个奇怪的时候。

lines.en: scene harukaandco20
: Oh, it’s fine. This is nothing compared to one of the girls I have to deal with pretty much every day.
lines.zh: : 哦,没关系。比起我几乎每天都要应付的一个女孩,这根本不算什么。

lines.en: : You have kids?
lines.zh: : 你有孩子?

lines.en: : Me? No way. Just a bunch of part timers at a cafe I own about a mile away from here.
lines.zh: : 我?才不是。就是我开的一家咖啡馆里的一群兼职生,离这儿大概一英里。

lines.en: scene harukaandco21
: Cafe?
lines.zh: : 咖啡馆?

lines.en: : Uhh...yeah. Like...you know. A place that serves coffee?
lines.zh: : 呃……对。就是……你知道的。卖咖啡的地方?

lines.en: : Dude, I know what a cafe is. I was just thinking that’s a crazy coincidence since my daughter also works at a cafe about a mile away from here.
lines.zh: : 老兄,我知道咖啡馆是什么。我只是觉得这也太巧了,因为我女儿也在离这儿大概一英里的一个咖啡馆打工。

lines.en: : I’m not allowed to go there, though. She says I’ll embarrass her. But I don’t seem that embarrassing, do I?
lines.zh: : 不过她不让我去。她说我会让她丢脸。可我看起来没那么丢人吧,对吧?

lines.en: : Um...just out of curiosity, your daughter wouldn’t happen to be-
lines.zh: : 嗯……只是好奇问一下,你女儿该不会是——

lines.en: scene harukaandco22
: Interested in coming to work for you instead? No way. She loves her job. Even {i}if{/i} I’m not allowed to go there. But nice try, random rival cafe lady.
lines.zh: : 想跳槽去你那儿?想都别想。她很爱她的工作。{i}就算{/i}我不被允许去那儿。不过谢了啊,素不相识的对家咖啡馆大姐。

lines.en: : What? No, I-
lines.zh: : 什么?不,我——

lines.en: : Anyway, it was nice talking to you! Hope that whoever you’re giving those flowers to likes the color blue and how aggressively apologetic it is!
lines.zh: : 总之,跟你聊天很开心!希望你要送花的那个人会喜欢蓝色,以及它那种「过于用力道歉」的感觉!

lines.en: scene harukaandco23
: Oh! And if you need a card as well, they’re to the right of the check-out counter!
lines.zh: : 哦!还有,如果你还需要卡片,就在收银台右边!

lines.en: : If you bend all the corners, they’ll even give you a discount!
lines.zh: : 要是你把四角都折起来,他们还会给你打折!

lines.en: : Anyway, bye! Time to go salvage my love life!
lines.zh: : 总之,拜拜!该去挽救我的爱情生活了!

lines.en: : Wait, miss. You still have to pay for-
lines.zh: : 等等,小姐。你还没付钱——

lines.en: : Sorry, can’t talk right now! Keep the change!
lines.zh: : 抱歉,现在没空聊!不用找了!

lines.en: : ...those.
lines.zh: : ……那些花。

lines.en: scene black
{i}Roughly one hour later, in a room less joyous.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}大约一小时之后,在一间不那么欢乐的房间里。{/i}

lines.en: scene harukaandco24
I have no poem nor words of consolation for you this time.
lines.zh: 这一次,我没有诗,也没有安慰的话给你。

lines.en: Just a glimpse into what may or may not be happening behind your back.
lines.zh: 只有一瞥,关于在你背后可能发生、也可能没发生的事。

lines.en: And how things can be painful even without you.
lines.zh: 以及,就算没有你在场,事情也可以有多痛。

lines.en: Sometimes, a tree falls so hard that it can be heard from miles away.
lines.zh: 有时候,一棵树倒下的声音大得几英里外都听得见。

lines.en: And other times-
lines.zh: 而另一些时候——

lines.en: It’s like an entire forest has collapsed.
lines.zh: 就像整片森林都塌了。

lines.en: : {b}FUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUCK!!!!!!!!!!!!{/b}
: FUCK FUCK FUCK FUCK FUCK! WHY US?! AM I NOT STRUGGLING ENOUGH ALREADY?! I NEED TO STRUGGLE {i}MORE?!{/i}
lines.zh: : 操操操操操!为什么是我们?!我还不够难吗?!我还得{i}更{/i}难吗?!

lines.en: : Hey...you’re going to be okay. You’ve been doing great without him. Much better than me, at least.
lines.zh: : 嘿……你会没事的。没有他,你一直做得很好。至少比我好得多。

lines.en: : I DON’T WANT TO DO IT WITHOUT HIM, SARA! I DON’T WANT TO DO THIS ALONE!
lines.zh: : 我不想要没有他的生活,SARA!我不想一个人扛!

lines.en: : I LOVED HIM! I {i}STILL{/i} LOVE HIM! AND NOW HE’S FUCKING GONE! JUST LIKE THAT! WITHOUT EVEN SAYING ANYTHING!
lines.zh: : 我爱过他!我到现在{i}还{/i}爱他!可现在他他妈的就这么走了!就这么!连句话都没留下!

lines.en: : DO YOU HAVE ANY IDEA WHAT THE LAST THING I SAID TO HIM WAS?! DO YOU?!
lines.zh: : 你知道我对他说的最后一句话是什么吗?!你知道吗?!

lines.en: : Maki...
lines.zh: : Maki……

lines.en: : Here! I’ll tell you! It was “Don’t fuck too many aliens!”
lines.zh: : 嘿!我来告诉你!是「别操太多外星人!」

lines.en: : {i}That{/i} was the last thing I ever said to him! And I can’t take that back!
lines.zh: : {i}那{/i}就是我对他说过的最后一句话!而我再也收不回来了!

lines.en: : I never thought something like this would happen, Sara! I never realized how cruel and unfair life can be!
lines.zh: : 我从没想过会发生这种事,Sara!我从没意识到生活可以这么残忍、这么不公平!

lines.en: scene harukaandco25
: I know...I know...
lines.zh: : 我知道……我知道……

lines.en: : It really is cruel, isn’t it?...
lines.zh: : 真的很残忍,不是吗?……

lines.en: : How we never realize how close to the end things are...
lines.zh: : 我们从来意识不到,事情离终点已经有多近……

lines.en: scene harukaandco26
: THAT FUCKING IDIOT!
lines.zh: : 那个该死的白痴!

lines.en: : WHY DID HE TELL ME EVERYTHING WOULD BE FINE?! WHY DID I BELIEVE HIM?!
lines.zh: : 他凭什么告诉我一切都会没事的?!我为什么要信他?!

lines.en: : THIS ISN’T FINE AT ALL! THAT FUCKING MORON! ASSHOLE! UNGRATEFUL BASTARD!
lines.zh: : 这根本一点都不好!那个他妈的蠢货!混蛋!没良心的王八蛋!

lines.en: : FUCKING...DOUCHEBAG! WORTHLESS PIECE OF SHIT! HOW COULD YOU FUCKING DO THIS TO US?!
lines.zh: : 他妈的……人渣!一文不值的废物!你怎么能他妈的这样对我们?!

lines.en: : That’s right...let it all out...
lines.zh: : 对……都发泄出来吧……

lines.en: : It’s okay to cry here...
lines.zh: : 在这里哭没关系的……

lines.en: scene harukaandco27
: WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAaaAaAAAAaaaaaahhh!!!!!!!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : 哇啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊!!!!!!!!!!!!!

lines.en: : MASAHIRO!!! YOU FUCKING ASSHOLE!!! HOW COULD YOU?!?! HOW COULD YOU?!?!?!?!?!
lines.zh: : MASAHIRO!!!你这个他妈的混蛋!!!你怎么能这样?!?!你怎么能?!?!?!?!?!

lines.en: : Maki...why did you hold this in for so long?
lines.zh: : Maki……你为什么把这些憋了这么久?

lines.en: : HOW THE FUCK WOULD YOU KNOW HOW LONG I’VE HELD IT IN, HARUKA?!
lines.zh: : 你他妈怎么会知道我憋了多久,HARUKA?!

lines.en: : WHILE YOU WERE BUSY CELEBRATING, I WAS BREAKING THE NEWS TO MY BABY GIRL THAT THE MAN SHE'S LOOKED UP TO SINCE SHE WAS LITTLE IS NEVER COMING HOME!
lines.zh: : 你忙着庆祝的时候,我正在告诉我的宝贝女儿,那个她从小就仰望的男人,永远不会回家了!

lines.en: : I’m not here to make excuses. Not being there for you was horrible of me. But you’ve always been the type to hold things in until they don’t fit anymore and-
lines.zh: : 我不是来辩解的。那天没在你身边,是我不对。可你向来都是那种把事情憋到再也装不下的人,而且——

lines.en: : THIS IS DIFFERENT!
lines.zh: : 这次不一样!

lines.en: : I {i}HAVE{/i} TO DO THAT NOW! IT’S NOT A CHOICE ANYMORE!
lines.zh: : 我现在{i}必须{/i}这样!这已经不是选择题了!

lines.en: : I’M A SINGLE FUCKING PARENT NOW! I HAVE TO BE STRONG!
lines.zh: : 我现在是他妈的单亲家长了!我必须坚强!

lines.en: : I CAN’T JUST FUCK AROUND ANYMORE! SOMEONE ELSE’S FEELINGS ARE AT STAKE!
lines.zh: : 我再也不能瞎混了!别人的感受都押在我身上!

lines.en: : I’m not saying you should fuck around...I’m saying that your daughter is smart enough to realize you’re hurting too and-
lines.zh: : 我不是说你该去瞎混……我是说,你女儿聪明到能看出来你也在痛,而且——

lines.en: scene sadflash1
scene sadflash2
scene sadflash3
scene harukaandco28
: STOP TALKING TO ME LIKE YOU UNDERSTAND WHAT’S GOING ON! STOP TALKING LIKE YOU UNDERSTAND HOW I FEEL!
lines.zh: : 别再用那种「我懂你在经历什么」的口气跟我说话!别再说得像你懂我的感受!

lines.en: : Maki! She was just trying to-
lines.zh: : Maki!她只是想——

lines.en: : SHE SHOULD HAVE BEEN THERE! SHE SHOULD HAVE BEEN THERE FOR ME!
lines.zh: : 她应该在的!她当时就该在我身边!

lines.en: scene harukaandco29
: How many times have you called me to cry about your problems?! How many times have I sat there listening to them?! Consoling you for things you shouldn’t even have to be consoled for!
lines.zh: : 你有多少次打电话给我哭诉你的问题?!我有多少次坐在那儿听你说?!安慰你那些根本不需要安慰的事!

lines.en: : Your husband is still alive and mine has been dead for two fucking months! Two months, Haruka!
lines.zh: : 你丈夫还活着,而我的已经死了整整两个月!两个月,Haruka!

lines.en: : My daughter lost her father and you didn’t even come over to see how we were doing!
lines.zh: : 我女儿失去了父亲,而你连过来看我们一眼都没有!

lines.en: : I called-
lines.zh: : 我打过——

lines.en: : ONE FUCKING TIME!
lines.zh: : 就他妈一次!

lines.en: : YOU CALLED ONE TIME!
lines.zh: : 你只打了一次!

lines.en: scene harukaandco30
: Is that seriously all I’m worth to you?
lines.zh: : 我在你心里就值这些吗?

lines.en: : Did you think you could just fucking show up here with {i}flowers{/i} in your hand and make it all okay?
lines.zh: : 你以为他妈的手里拿束{i}花{/i}出现在这里,一切就能和好了?

lines.en: scene harukaandco31
: Don’t tell me I shouldn’t be holding things in when letting them out makes the whole world fucking implode.
lines.zh: : 别跟我说我不该把事憋着——放出来的结果是整个世界他妈的内爆。

lines.en: : And don’t pity me either. Because the idea of someone who can’t handle her own problems telling me how to handle {i}mine{/i} is just insulting.
lines.zh: : 也别可怜我。因为一个连自己的问题都处理不好的人,来教我怎么处理{i}我的{/i}问题,这简直是一种侮辱。

lines.en: : She doesn’t mean that, Haru-chan...She doesn’t.
lines.zh: : 她不是那个意思,Haru-chan……她不是。

lines.en: : It’s not fair.
lines.zh: : 这不公平。

lines.en: : It’s just not fair.
lines.zh: : 就是不公平。

lines.en: : Why couldn’t my husband live too?
lines.zh: : 为什么活下来的不能是我丈夫?

lines.en: : Why couldn’t I have gotten the same call you did?
lines.zh: : 为什么接到那通电话的不能是我?

lines.en: scene harukaandco32
: Because I’m lucky...theres nothing more to it than that.
lines.zh: : 因为我很幸运……没有别的原因。

lines.en: : If the outcome of our phone calls was based on who we are as people or how decent we’ve been to each other...I know our positions would be swapped right now.
lines.zh: : 如果我们那两通电话的结果,是按我们是什么样的人、或者我们对彼此有多好来决定的……我知道现在我们的位置会调过来。

lines.en: : And I know that you would have been the first one to get in contact with me.
lines.zh: : 而且我知道,你会是第一个来联系我的人。

lines.en: : I wasn’t, and I’m sorry for that. I’ll be sorry for it for the rest of my life.
lines.zh: : 我没有,对此我很抱歉。我这辈子都会为此抱歉。

lines.en: : What I won’t do is give up on telling you when I think you’re making things harder for yourself than they have to be.
lines.zh: : 但我不会放弃一件事:当我认为你在把事情弄得比必要的更难时,我会说出口。

lines.en: : No one’s expecting you to hold yourself together, and I’m sure that includes your daughter.
lines.zh: : 没有人指望你能一直撑着不倒,我相信你女儿也不指望。

lines.en: scene harukaandco33
: Also, I didn’t buy you these flowers to try and make everything okay. I bought them because I think you deserve something nice now that everything else has been taken away from you.
lines.zh: : 还有,我买这些花不是为了把一切变好。我买它们,是因为我觉得既然别的都被夺走了,你该得到一点好东西。

lines.en: : And also because I was pressured into it by some woman in the convenience store who may or may not be the mother of one of my employees.
lines.zh: : 也因为我在便利店被一个女人逼着买的,而她可能是、也可能不是我某个员工的妈妈。

lines.en: : The point is, I wasn’t there for you when I should have been.
lines.zh: : 重点是,我本该在你身边的时候没在。

lines.en: : But I’m here now, asking for forgiveness when I know I don’t deserve it because beneath the selfishness and inability to look forward, I love you.
lines.zh: : 但我现在在这儿,明知自己不配,还是要求你原谅——因为在我的自私和不会向前看之下,我爱你。

lines.en: scene harukaandco34
: Haruka, I...I didn’t mean to hit you. I’m just...
lines.zh: : Haruka,我……我不是故意打你的。我只是……

lines.en: : It really hurts...
lines.zh: : 真的很痛……

lines.en: : I’ve never felt so alone before...
lines.zh: : 我从没这么孤独过……

lines.en: : Sara, can you take these flowers from me for a second?
lines.zh: : Sara,你能帮我把花接一下吗?

lines.en: : Huh?...Sure, but...
scene harukaandco35
: Come here.
lines.zh: : 过来。

lines.en: : I don’t care that you hit me, Maki. It’s not a big deal.
lines.zh: : 我不在乎你打我,Maki。这没什么。

lines.en: : You’re...{i}sniff...{/i}only saying that because...{i}sniff...{/i}you like it rough...
lines.zh: : 你……{i}抽泣{/i}……这么说只是因为……{i}抽泣{/i}……你喜欢粗暴一点……

lines.en: : No. I’m saying that because after all of the times you’ve been there for me, the least I can do to make it up to you is let you knock me around a little bit.
lines.zh: : 不是。我这么说是因为,在你那么多次陪在我身边之后,我能用来补偿你的最起码的事,就是让你揍我几下。

lines.en: : Just...{i}sniff...{/i}be there for {i}me.{/i} That’s all I want...
lines.zh: : 只要……{i}抽泣{/i}……陪着{i}我{/i}就好。我就只要这个……

lines.en: : I will. I promise.
lines.zh: : 我会的。我保证。

lines.en: : But in the meantime, cry as much as you want. I took the day off to spend it with you. And if that means becoming a handkerchief, so be it.
lines.zh: : 但在此期间,你想哭就哭个够。我今天请了假来陪你。如果这意味着我要当一块手帕,那就当吧。

lines.en: : Also, I hope that you’re okay with blue. The girl at the convenience store said it might be too “aggressively apologetic.”
lines.zh: : 还有,希望你能接受蓝色。便利店那个女孩说,它可能「道歉得太用力」了。

lines.en: : {i}Sniff...{/i}
: Blue is my favorite color...
lines.zh: : 蓝色是我最喜欢的颜色……

lines.en: scene black
scene bedroom_night
Again, I can’t recall where the day went.
lines.zh: 我又想不起来这一天去哪儿了。

lines.en: After leaving the cafe, I wandered the streets...half-expecting to bump into a girl fighting a war with herself behind the scenes, trying to reclaim what little sense of dignity I haven’t already robbed her of.
lines.zh: 离开咖啡馆之后,我在街上漫无目的地走……一半期待着能撞见那个正在幕后与自己开战的女孩,试图夺回我还没从她身上抢走的那一丁点尊严。

lines.en: The fact that I didn’t find her at all speaks volumes about the shape she must be in right now.
lines.zh: 而我根本没找到她,这件事本身就说明她现在的状态有多糟。

lines.en: But at least she’s not alone in her misery- for even further behind the curtain are two more girls.
lines.zh: 但至少她不是独自承受这份痛苦——因为在更深的帷幕后面,还有两个女孩。

lines.en: They both wear glasses. Both have blue eyes. And they both just lost a man who, even in death, will remain far more important to them than I ever will.
lines.zh: 她们都戴眼镜。都有蓝色的眼睛。而且她们都刚失去了一个男人——那个男人即便死了,对她们的重要性也远胜于我。

lines.en: Which is why I’m not with them right now.
lines.zh: 这就是为什么我现在不在她们身边。

lines.en: Sometimes, it’s necessary to settle for second place.
lines.zh: 有时候,接受第二名是必要的。

lines.en: It’s necessary to detach yourself from things you became unintentionally glued to.
lines.zh: 把自己从那些无意间黏上的东西上撕开,是必要的。

lines.en: To slip out of your skin...and wander deep into the darkness, for that’s the only place you won’t be able to hurt anyone.
lines.zh: 从自己的皮里脱出来……然后走进黑暗深处,因为那里是唯一一个你伤不到任何人的地方。

lines.en: scene black
But sometimes, the ones you fear hurting find {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: 但有时候,你害怕伤害的人会找到{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: Because, contrary to what you may believe-
lines.zh: 因为,与你所以为的相反——

lines.en: You are never truly alone in the dark.
lines.zh: 在黑暗中,你从不曾真正孤身一人。

lines.en: {i}In the bowels of the night, unconscious as you are, you swallow a spider.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}在夜的深处,你毫无知觉地吞下了一只蜘蛛。{/i}

lines.en: {i}You awaken with a mouth full of eggs.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你醒来时,满嘴都是卵。{/i}
